title: the Kuiper Line Rising Revisited
author: Mirabel Thornbury
blurb: Odile Villalobos, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
